registration_policy: Each returned generation batch gets one fixed scale+translation from its common design coordinates. No per-frame bbox registration, tracking, local shift, or lower-half splice. All output frames use one world crop, size and clip selection mapping.
nod_policy: First frame is approved new idle canonical exactly. Subsequent frames preserve that newly drawn static body, hair/horns/feet; use genuine new generated connected active shoulder-arm-palm-finger edits and interior downward gaze, without rigid head rotation.
gesture_policy: Full newly painted figures, preserve correct first-sheet cells 0,1,6,7,8; replace middle four with approved key126 plus actually painted 125,127,128. No prior lower-body copy.
